title: chore(changeset): backfill changesets for post-9.3 changes
body:
Backfills the changesets that were missed for package-touching PRs merged after the **9.3.0** release (`objectstack-vscode@9.3.0`).

Scanned every non-merge commit in `objectstack-vscode@9.3.0..HEAD`; added one changeset per logical change that landed without one:

| Package(s) | Bump | Change |
|---|---|---|
| `objectql` | minor | opt-in `sys_metadata` hydration for isolated kernels (#1826) |
| `objectql` | patch | seed reference `id` fallback (#1814) |
| `objectql` | minor | ADR-0048 namespace install gate + package-scoped resolution (#1810) |
| `service-ai` | minor | `visualize_data` tool (#1820) |
| `service-ai` | minor | steer agent to `visualize_data` (#1821) |
| `service-ai` | minor | open framework AI query-only (#1803) |
| `service-ai` + `spec` | patch | cross-language current-object resolution (#1815) |
| `driver-sql` | patch | unknown `$select` column must not zero results (#1818) |
| `spec` | minor | ADR-0047 list-page form (#1817) |
| `spec` | minor | page form filter-mode widget (#1812) |

Commits already carrying a changeset, merges, and `chore: bump objectui` pins were skipped. `npx changeset status` resolves cleanly.
